title: Free Shipping Excludes the Exact Threshold
description:
`qualifies_for_free_shipping(cart_total)` should return `True` for orders of $50 or more. Right now an order of exactly $50 doesn't qualify. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`qualifies_for_free_shipping(cart_total: float) -> bool`

**Example**
`qualifies_for_free_shipping(50)` -> `True`, `qualifies_for_free_shipping(49.99)` -> `False`.
